name: sport-analytics-tool
description: Event-driven sports analytics platform for COMS3011A.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/batch-processing && npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/object-storage && npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend && npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/worker
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:api && npm run test:worker && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:deployment && npm run test:ci-routing
scripts.test:backend: npm run test --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend && npm run test:database
scripts.test:backend:local: npm run test --workspace=@sport-analytics/backend && npm run test:database:local
scripts.test:ci: npm run test && npm run test:database && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run structure:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build --workspace=@sport-analytics/contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run openapi:lint && npm run build
scripts.hygiene: npm run hygiene:knip && npm run hygiene:dependencies && npm run hygiene:architecture
scripts.hygiene:architecture: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs apps/frontend/src apps/backend/src apps/worker/src packages/contracts/src packages/batch-processing/src packages/object-storage/src
